data.title: bn-1hv: Settle acquired runs and stage publication atomically
data.description: Review atomic settlement and candidate staging for an acquired keyed run, exact receipt and snapshot validation, preservation of finalized staging and head CAS, and idempotent reconciliation after the first Investigation write is interrupted. Focused publication tests, strict all-target all-feature Clippy, and serialized just check passed.

data.body: HIGH: Require exact candidate lineage before settling. This predicate only proves that each durable flow original appears somewhere in inputs, and the adjacent experiment check is likewise existential. An extra artifact, or omission of a record-only accounting/edit-surface artifact, can therefore pass this transaction: put_run finalizes the run and releases its conflicts, then the mismatched candidate commits. The later verifier reevaluation rejects it because expected_inputs != lineage_inputs, leaving a finalized run with an unreconcilable pending candidate; retrying with corrected inputs then conflicts with the immutable staged bytes at lines 1201-1203. That violates the acceptance rule that a mismatched candidate leave no partial settlement/candidate. Derive the exact ordered candidate inputs from the record plus the linked experiment inside this transaction and require equality; add extra-input and missing-record-input regressions that assert audit state, run, conflicts, and publication are unchanged.

data.reason: HIGH th-3omztv: atomic settlement accepts non-exact candidate input lineage, allowing a finalized run and immutable pending candidate that later reevaluation cannot reconcile.

data.body: Fixed in 6e64a435ad9ac73aed5beb36bd104857d8a1bed9. Store now reconstructs the linked experiment reference and requires ordered equality with the complete canonical record lineage before writing settlement. The same production lineage derivation drives verifier preparation and reconciliation. The regression covers extra, omitted edit-surface, duplicate, reordered, substituted-identity, and swapped-digest inputs and checks unchanged run, conflict ownership, audit, checkpoint, and publication.

data.reason: Exact canonical lineage enforced before atomic settlement and covered by rollback regressions.
